question: 'Tippani Nritya' is associated with which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tippani is a form of folk dance that originated from the Chorwad and Veraval region of Saurashtra in Gujarat, India.
 
• It is also known as ‘Malta Dance’ or ‘Tippani Nritya’.
 
• This dance form is practised during the time of Hindu festivals such as Holi and Diwali or during the wedding ceremonies in the Gujarati community.
 
• Tippani dance holds an esteemed position during the contemporary times of India.
 
• Gujaratis all over the world performs this dance form as part of their family wedding ritual.
